summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching a private indenture for its 11th issue of simple, non-convertible debentures in a single series, under an automatic registration procedure for professional investors in Brazil. The debentures are a debt instrument, not equity-linked. No price per share, premium, or special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, tender offer, restructuring) is stated. The filing is a routine debt offering. The role is issuer, as AXIA Energia is the borrower. No special-situation event triggers a classification.
